description: Native LTX 1.6.2 two-stage pipeline using the exact mixed BF16/NVFP4 checkpoint, the nvfp4-prequant loader and NVFP4-aware distilled refinement LoRA fusion, spatial upscaler, and Gemma 3 companion closure. The pipeline runs with --offload cpu (block streaming) because the resident loader faulted on LTX v1.6.1 during model build; this is a diagnostic setting pending hardware acceptance. The image builds the pinned native NVFP4 kernels for Spark SM121. The conservative 89 GB peak and 8 GB reserve cover the 49 GB Gemma encoder or 20 GB checkpoint plus 8 GB LoRA, transient fusion and inference buffers; physical Spark acceptance remains required.
title: LTX-2 19B dev FP4 native pipeline single Spark (superseded)
